role: singleton daemon supervision, event-triggered chain launch, schedule launch, and stalled run recovery

watchdog.loop: check pty-manager, scan runs, cleanup orphans, reconcile tasks

event_triggers.condition_policy: reject shell metacharacters and fail closed

watchdog_recovery.stall_condition: running run has no alive session/monitor/grace and running or pending agents
watchdog_recovery.preferred_write: watchdog-stop-run from run-lib under shared run lock
watchdog_recovery.event: diagnostic run-stalled event, not canonical agent handoff

invariants: do not treat stale age as dead if PTY session is live
do not kill live monitor sessions
watchdog diagnostic events do not use canonical agent handoff shape
watcher idempotency uses handled markers, not processed mutation
